interpretation_ko: 많은 고투 끝의 평화와 안락을 뜻함
interpretation_en: are representatives of peace and comfort after many struggles

cite.original: Pipes seen in dreams, are representatives of peace and comfort after many struggles.
cite.translation_ko: 파이프가 나오는 꿈은, 많은 고투 끝의 평화와 안락을 뜻한다

interpretation_en: denotes unusual thought and prosperity in your community

cite.original: Sewer, gas, and such like pipes, denotes unusual thought and prosperity in your community.
cite.translation_ko: 하수관·가스관 같은 파이프를 보는 꿈은, 이색적인 생각과 마을의 번영을 뜻한다

interpretation_en: signifies ill health and stagnation of business

cite.original: Old and broken pipe, signifies ill health and stagnation of business.
cite.translation_ko: 낡고 부서진 파이프를 보는 꿈은, 건강 악화와 사업 정체를 뜻한다

interpretation_ko: 옛 벗의 방문을 반기고 다툼이 평화롭게 풀릴 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that you will enjoy the visit of an old friend, and peaceful settlements of differences will also take place

cite.original: To dream that you smoke a pipe, denotes that you will enjoy the visit of an old friend, and peaceful settlements of differences will also take place.
cite.translation_ko: 파이프 담배를 피우는 꿈은, 옛 벗의 방문을 반기고 다툼이 평화롭게 풀릴 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that you will be exposed to the evil designs of false friends

cite.original: To dream of pirates, denotes that you will be exposed to the evil designs of false friends.
cite.translation_ko: 해적 꿈은, 거짓 친구의 흉계에 노출될 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 친구와 옛 동료의 무리에서 떨어져 나갈 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that you will fall beneath the society of friends and former equals

cite.original: To dream that you are a pirate, denotes that you will fall beneath the society of friends and former equals.
cite.translation_ko: 제가 해적이 되는 꿈은, 친구와 옛 동료의 무리에서 떨어져 나갈 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 애인이 못 미덥고 남을 속일 사람임을 알리는 징조
interpretation_en: is a sign of his unworthiness and deceitfulness

cite.original: For a young woman to dream that her lover is a pirate, is a sign of his unworthiness and deceitfulness.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 애인이 해적임을 꿈꾸면, 애인이 못 미덥고 남을 속일 사람임을 알리는 징조다

interpretation_ko: 거짓 핑계에 속아 집을 떠나게 될 조짐
interpretation_en: she will be induced to leave her home under false pretenses

cite.original: If she is captured by pirates, she will be induced to leave her home under false pretenses.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 해적에게 붙잡히는 꿈은, 거짓 핑계에 속아 집을 떠나게 될 조짐이다
